note: List (stills): five official Halloween events running this week, each confirmed on the publisher's own page 08:05Z (Pokémon GO Halloween 2026 Part I to 1 Nov 10:00 local; Roblox The Hollow 22 Oct to 2 Nov; CoD Mobile Season 9 Vampires vs Werewolves from 14 Oct; Apex Legends Blood Pact 13 Oct to 3 Nov; Overwatch Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games 6 Oct to 2 Nov). Official key art only (no event trailers off YouTube); Free Fire art left out (dark, blood-like stains). Our halloween bed (stills). v2: the Pokémon GO line moves to the top, off the game logo.
